readerCopy.body: Someone else's refusal to keep following the old rules can expose how much comfort depended on their continued cooperation. When Uranus opposes Lilith, disruption and autonomy face each other directly, making a changed boundary, exit, unconventional choice, or demand for freedom difficult to absorb without renegotiating the surrounding structure. The refusal may be inconvenient without being negotiable. The next arrangement becomes clearer once the old expectation is no longer treated as something another person is required to restore.
